page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 8 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and does not include a GPU. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers weak to average performance. In stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, the instance ranks in the bottom 25%. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and text processing scores fall into the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score remains in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read-only performance for both small and large blocks, though large block write bandwidth reaches average levels. Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests also register in the average range, but database operations and Redis SET performance are weak.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation but lower-tier benchmark results, the ecs.sn2.xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that require dedicated cores but do not demand high-frequency compute power. The absence of local storage means all storage operations must rely on network-attached volumes, which, combined with the 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, may limit I/O-heavy applications. This instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as basic web serving, light application hosting, or small-scale development environments where predictable CPU allocation is preferred over raw processing speed.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance featuring 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, but lacks local storage and GPU acceleration. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Performance benchmarks place this server primarily in the weak to average categories, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores landing in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Large block memory write bandwidth and Passmark CPU scores reach average levels. Lacking local storage and high-speed networking, the ecs.sn2.xlarge is best suited for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and development environments that require dedicated CPU resources without demanding high-performance compute or storage throughput.
